{
  "project_id": "P-MNG-ThirdEnergySector",
  "risks": [
    {
      "risk_id": "R01",
      "description": "Electricity tariffs set below service costs create severe financial deficits for utilities, reaching up to 36 percent of system costs by 2025.",
      "category": "financial",
      "likelihood": 4,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Conduct analytical studies to support the government in executing electricity tariff reform strategies ensuring sector financial viability.",
      "evidence": "The current electricity price is below the cost of service causing financial difficulties for sector utilities."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R02",
      "description": "Single-circuit 220kV transmission line between Baganuur and Choir creates a critical system bottleneck, limiting renewable energy evacuation and integration.",
      "category": "technical",
      "likelihood": 4,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Construct a new 220kV double-circuit transmission line from Baganuur to Choir and expand associated substations.",
      "evidence": "the crucial Baganuur-Choir corridor remains as a bottleneck for power transmission because it lacks redundancy with only a single circuit 220kV line."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R03",
      "description": "High combined transmission and distribution losses (13.4 percent) and lack of grid redundancy cause severe power outages in the Central Energy System.",
      "category": "technical",
      "likelihood": 4,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Strengthen high-voltage grid redundancy by constructing a double-circuit 220kV line and adding new substation feeders.",
      "evidence": "combined transmission and distribution losses in CES in 2021 remained high at 13.4 percent."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R04",
      "description": "Aging coal-fired combined heat and power plants dominate domestic generation, making power dispatch inflexible and complicating variable renewable energy integration.",
      "category": "technical",
      "likelihood": 4,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Utilize utility-scale battery energy storage systems, reinforce high-voltage transmission lines, and conduct long-term grid planning studies.",
      "evidence": "Most of the CHP units are aging (the youngest one is more than 40 years old), inefficient and highly polluting."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R05",
      "description": "Domestic power shortfalls create a high dependency on Russian power imports (nearly 20 percent), exposing the grid to external supply risks.",
      "category": "external",
      "likelihood": 4,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Expand domestic renewable energy integration and increase transmission transfer capacity along high-demand economic corridors.",
      "evidence": "domestic generation was falling short of demand and Mongolia’s dependency on Russian imports reached almost 20 percent in 2022."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R06",
      "description": "Administrative and technical capacity constraints in implementing entities risk repeating historical implementation delays on major infrastructure projects.",
      "category": "organizational",
      "likelihood": 4,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Establish a dedicated PMO under the Ministry of Energy and recruit an Owner's Engineer to support procurement and supervision.",
      "evidence": "Previous infrastructure projects in Mongolia have experienced implementation delays due to the administrative and technical capacity constraints of the implementing agencies."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R07",
      "description": "The short weather-dependent construction window in Mongolia risks multi-month project delays if transmission line construction spans across winter.",
      "category": "schedule",
      "likelihood": 4,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Initiate advance procurement, apply rated criteria evaluating construction timeline optimization, and structure works into geographical lots.",
      "evidence": "Once construction of transmission lines and its associated substations contract start, it should be completed within one construction season."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R08",
      "description": "High dependence on imported construction materials (75-80%) and specialized 220kV equipment exposes the project to border delays and supply chain inflation.",
      "category": "external",
      "likelihood": 4,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Utilize international competitive bidding via Request for Bids, perform supply market intelligence, and actively monitor supply chain logistics.",
      "evidence": "The construction sector in Mongolia has been heavily reliant on imports, with statistics showing that 75-80% of construction materials are sourced from outside the country."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R09",
      "description": "Overhead high-voltage transmission lines pose collision and electrocution hazards to avifauna and risk disturbing sensitive bird habitats.",
      "category": "environmental",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Re-route transmission line alignment away from wetlands, install bird flight diverters, and execute a comprehensive Bird Management Plan.",
      "evidence": "Transmission lines in Mongolia often involve bird collision and other biodiversity issues, to which attention and efforts have been insufficient"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R10",
      "description": "Creation of a new PMO with staff lacking prior World Bank experience could cause delays in financial reporting and internal control deficiencies.",
      "category": "financial",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Adopt a comprehensive Financial Management Manual prior to effectiveness and conduct mandatory World Bank FM and disbursement training.",
      "evidence": "PMO is not yet in place and no financial management staff has been appointed"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R11",
      "description": "Exposure to severe winter conditions, extreme cold, and high wind loading could damage transmission towers, lines, and substation equipment.",
      "category": "environmental",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Incorporate enhanced structural engineering standards for high wind loading, rated extreme design temperatures, and improved insulator designs.",
      "evidence": "exposure to drought and extreme cold identified as the strongest drivers of risk."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R12",
      "description": "Evaluation Committee members lacking experience with World Bank regulations and English bidding documents may cause procurement delays and evaluation errors.",
      "category": "schedule",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Provide specialized procurement training to Evaluation Committee members, define explicit scoring rules, and submit evaluation documents for World Bank review.",
      "evidence": "Evaluation Committee members normally do not have knowledge and experience in handling English documents, and it may cause delays"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R13",
      "description": "Civil works and maintenance on high-voltage transmission lines create severe OHS hazards including electrocution, falling from height, and EMF exposure.",
      "category": "technical",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Enforce World Bank Group EHS Guidelines, adopt national standard MNS6518:2015, and mandate strict contractor safety plans.",
      "evidence": "occupational health and safety (OHS) risks associated with live power lines, working at height, electric and magnetic fields (EMF)."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R14",
      "description": "Systemic gender-based biases in power utilities impede female recruitment, training access, and promotion into technical and management roles.",
      "category": "organizational",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 2,
      "mitigation": "Execute a workforce gender assessment, institute gender-responsive HR policies, provide female leadership training, and set baseline tracking targets.",
      "evidence": "gender-based biases may be an obstacle to women’s employment and especially to career progression at NPTG."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R15",
      "description": "Civil works along transmission right-of-way may temporarily restrict local herders' access to pasture, wells, and local transit routes.",
      "category": "stakeholder",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 2,
      "mitigation": "Conduct stakeholder consultations, implement the Resettlement Policy Framework (RPF), and operate an accessible two-stage Grievance Redress Mechanism.",
      "evidence": "temporary restriction of access to resources by local herders (for example, pasture, wells, etc.) and sensitive receptors"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R16",
      "description": "Government elections and potential political turnover or high-level official interference may disrupt project decision-making and delay procurement.",
      "category": "political_regulatory",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Establish a cross-agency Project Steering Committee, maintain government continuity planning, and formalize decision-making workflows in the POM.",
      "evidence": "Interference of the high-level officials in procurement decision making which leads to delays."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R17",
      "description": "Delays or shortfalls in providing required government counterpart funding ($840,000) could disrupt capacity building and operational support activities.",
      "category": "financial",
      "likelihood": 2,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Include legal covenant obligating annual state budget allocation and periodic reporting on counterpart funds status.",
      "evidence": "provide or cause to be provided, in a timely manner, adequate counterpart funds, in the minimum amount of $840,000 equivalent"
    }
  ]
}

risks.description: Electricity tariffs set below service costs create severe financial deficits for utilities, reaching up to 36 percent of system costs by 2025.
risks.mitigation: Conduct analytical studies to support the government in executing electricity tariff reform strategies ensuring sector financial viability.
risks.evidence: The current electricity price is below the cost of service causing financial difficulties for sector utilities.

risks.description: Single-circuit 220kV transmission line between Baganuur and Choir creates a critical system bottleneck, limiting renewable energy evacuation and integration.
risks.mitigation: Construct a new 220kV double-circuit transmission line from Baganuur to Choir and expand associated substations.
risks.evidence: the crucial Baganuur-Choir corridor remains as a bottleneck for power transmission because it lacks redundancy with only a single circuit 220kV line.

risks.description: High combined transmission and distribution losses (13.4 percent) and lack of grid redundancy cause severe power outages in the Central Energy System.
risks.mitigation: Strengthen high-voltage grid redundancy by constructing a double-circuit 220kV line and adding new substation feeders.
risks.evidence: combined transmission and distribution losses in CES in 2021 remained high at 13.4 percent.

risks.description: Aging coal-fired combined heat and power plants dominate domestic generation, making power dispatch inflexible and complicating variable renewable energy integration.
risks.mitigation: Utilize utility-scale battery energy storage systems, reinforce high-voltage transmission lines, and conduct long-term grid planning studies.
risks.evidence: Most of the CHP units are aging (the youngest one is more than 40 years old), inefficient and highly polluting.

risks.description: Domestic power shortfalls create a high dependency on Russian power imports (nearly 20 percent), exposing the grid to external supply risks.
